_comment: Fallback data for providers whose pricing pages are client-rendered or bot-blocked. Prices per 1M tokens (USD). source=seed shows in the UI as 'verified'. capabilities keys: vision, audio, tools, reasoning, caching, batch, fine_tune, open_weights. features = 5 short capability points, deliberately free of hard numbers so they do not go stale.

openai.best_for: Hard reasoning, agentic work and tool use
features: Flagship reasoning across long, multi-step tasks
Built for agentic tool use and function calling
Very large context window for whole-repo or whole-doc work
Text and image input
Prompt caching and batch discounts available
